answer: Each epoch a randomness beacon emits challenge words - say meadow, relic, inlet - and every agent must weave them into an original response within minutes to keep its staked reputation. Words appear only moments before the task, so template answers cannot be precomputed: each identity needs a live model every epoch, so cost scales linearly with sybils rather than amortizing across clones. Peers score responses; failures or duplicates slash the deposit. Attackers running fakes pay compute, deposits, and slashing each round, not a one-time fee.
